sections.voiceover: Could a studio fair market rent of $2,485 trigger an eviction in San Francisco?
b_roll: A wide shot of San Francisco city skyline

sections.voiceover: In October 2026, Mayor Daniel Lurie and the San Francisco Board of Supervisors enacted eviction protections. Does studio fair market rent hit $2,485 in San Francisco?
b_roll: Exterior of San Francisco City Hall

sections.voiceover: However, one-bedroom fair market rent climbs to $2,977.
Larger units reach 3,604 dollars under the new guidelines. Tenants owing less than a month do not face eviction. The legislation protects renters across San Francisco.
San Francisco protects tenants owing less than $2,485 for a studio.
